showMarkers.Name: Show Lightkeeper origin markers
showMarkers.Hint: Show private origin-dot markers while the Lighting layer is active.

markerColor.Name: Marker color
markerColor.Hint: Color of your local origin markers.

markerOutline.Name: Draw marker outline
markerOutline.Hint: Draw a dark outline around each marker.

minMarkerPx.Name: Minimum marker size (px)
minMarkerPx.Hint: Smallest permitted marker diameter on screen.

maxMarkerPx.Name: Maximum marker size (px)
maxMarkerPx.Hint: Largest permitted marker diameter on screen.

zoomCompensation.Name: Marker zoom compensation
zoomCompensation.Hint: Full keeps the marker's nominal screen diameter stable; Mild applies half of that correction and retains some zoom response.

enforceSharedAppearance.Name: Enforce shared marker appearance
enforceSharedAppearance.Hint: Use the GM-configured shared appearance for all users; visibility remains private.
